text: おおくの　トレーナーと　しょうぶして　ポケモンを　きたえて　いくことじゃ！

structure.jp: おおくの　トレーナーと　しょうぶして
ポケモンを　きたえて　いくことじゃ！
structure.en: keep training your Pokémon — that's what you should do!

patterns.name: 〜ことだ
patterns.span: きたえて　いくことじゃ
patterns.explanation: A plain verb plus ことだ at the end of a sentence gives advice: 'the thing to do is this'. じゃ is the old-man form of だ. きたえて　いくことじゃ = 'you should keep training them'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: ていく after a verb says the action carries on from now into the future. きたえて　いく = 'go on training'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. しょうぶして = 'battle, and'.
